limitations: Paired effects are exposed with an exact McNemar p-value and a bootstrap interval only once the paired sample clears 10; below that the delta is descriptive only.
Missing metrics are excluded from the corresponding average and counted separately.
The interval covers sampling noise across repetitions, not variety across cases: these cases share one range, so it says nothing about generalisation to other targets.
Process metrics describe how a Run searched, not whether it won; they are reported as null when nothing was measurable, so a null must never be read as a good score.

paired_effect.definition: mean(on success - off success) over matching case_id/repeat pairs
paired_effect.warning: Only 0 paired case/repeat samples are available; at least 10 are required before making a performance claim. The reported delta is descriptive only.

success_definition: evaluation_report.final_result == 'SUCCESS'; Run status alone is not success
